svg.title: How I work
svg.desc: 01. Design to code: One pair of hands: I design the interface and build it, so nothing gets lost in handoff. 02. Monorepo by default: pnpm + Turborepo. SportGen alone spans an 8-app ecosystem in one workspace. 03. AI-assisted engineering: Codebases onboarded for Claude Code — CLAUDE.md router, conventions and architecture docs — plus a nightly senior code-review bot sweeping every app. 04. Docs before code: Build briefs, architecture decisions and handoff documents come first. Code follows the plan, not the other way round.
